text: The 2015-16 Warriors went 73-9, the best regular season record ever, then lost the NBA Finals to the Cleveland Cavaliers after leading 3-1.
Stephen Curry won the 2016 MVP award unanimously, the first unanimous MVP in NBA history, after a season of record three pointers.
Klay Thompson scored 37 points in a single quarter against the Sacramento Kings in 2015, an NBA record.
Draymond Green won Defensive Player of the Year in 2017, anchoring the Warriors defense with switching and passing.
Kevin Durant joined the Warriors in 2016 and won Finals MVP in 2017 and 2018.
Erling Haaland scored 36 Premier League goals in 2022-23, a new record for a single season.
Manchester City won four Premier League titles in a row from 2021 to 2024 under Pep Guardiola.
Rodri scored the only goal as Manchester City beat Inter Milan in the 2023 Champions League final in Istanbul.
Kevin De Bruyne is famous for his passing and assists from midfield for Manchester City.
Pep Guardiola teams keep the ball with short passing, a style called positional play.
Chennai Super Kings have won the IPL five times: 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021 and 2023.
In the 2023 IPL final, Ravindra Jadeja hit a six and a four off the last two balls to win the title for Chennai.
Chennai Super Kings returned in 2018 after a two year suspension and won the IPL title that same season.
Fans call MS Dhoni Thala. He captained Chennai Super Kings to most of their titles with calm finishing.
Chepauk is a slow pitch where spin bowlers thrive, giving Chennai a home advantage.
Rick escapes prison in the season three premiere and rants about Szechuan sauce from McDonalds.
Mr Meeseeks is a blue creature who exists to complete one task and then vanish. Existence is pain to a Meeseeks.
The Citadel of Ricks is a city run by thousands of Ricks and Mortys from different dimensions.
Rick hacks the TV to show interdimensional cable, random shows from other universes.
Birdperson is the oldest friend of Rick, a half bird warrior who fought beside him in a rebellion.
Vijay is called Thalapathy by his fans. He launched the political party Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam in 2024.
In Master, Vijay plays JD, an alcoholic professor sent to a juvenile school, facing a villain played by Vijay Sethupathi.
In Thuppakki, Vijay plays an army officer on leave who hunts sleeper cells in Mumbai.
Mersal features Vijay in a triple role, including a doctor who charges five rupees.
In Beast, Vijay plays a former RAW agent trapped in a hijacked Chennai mall.
Leo is part of the Lokesh Cinematic Universe, directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj.
